name: Jarvis 30.0
notes: New Performance Ranking: Top N / Bottom N SSR by ASM wise (any number), and lists like SSR with achievement less than or equal to 40% (any %, any condition: below, above, between). Works on Achievement % (target file) or Growth % (billing file). One combined sheet or one sheet per ASM. Dealer GOLY / GOLM Report can now filter dealers by growth % or show top N dealers. Decimal quantities show 2 decimals.
